name: PsyRX CNS Bio-Tech Ltd
summary: PsyRX CNS Bio-Tech Ltd is dedicated to developing cannabinoid-based pharmaceuticals and healthcare products. Its portfolio encompasses drugs targeting diverse medical conditions, personalized cannabinoid formulations, and CBD-infused skincare along with food supplements. Established in 2019, the company, formerly known as Cannabotech LTD, is headquartered in Rishon LeZion, Israel.
